message:
Set the encryption level on the network thread instead of setting it on the main thread
- ensures we don't set the encryption level before the client recieved approved (existing issue) and ensure batches are flushed before the packet is sent (new issue)

Fix favorites and history not listing reliably in the server browser
- Favoriting a server saves IP:port straight away, then its favendpoint if the server reports one
- favorites.cfg saves each hostname's last resolved IP:port so queries generally succeed even if the DNS queries haven't finished yet
- Hostnames that fail DNS queries for 30+ days revert to IP:port so they don't log failures forever
- "No servers found" no longer shows over results while a refresh or a feeding list is still loading
